trans.sense: any of various invertebrate animals that belong to the phylum Cnidaria

examples.text: A general feature of cnidarians, as I noted above, is their stinging cells.
examples.ref: 2016, Peter Godfrey-Smith, Other Minds, William Collins, published 2018, page 35:

raw_glosses: (zoology) Any of various invertebrate animals, such as jellyfish, hydras, sea anemones, corals and formerly sponges and ctenophores that belong to the phylum Cnidaria.
glosses: Any of various invertebrate animals, such as jellyfish, hydras, sea anemones, corals and formerly sponges and ctenophores that belong to the phylum Cnidaria.

raw_glosses: (biology) A capsule, in certain cnidarians, containing a barbed, string-like tube that transfers a paralyzing sting.
glosses: A capsule, in certain cnidarians, containing a barbed, string-like tube that transfers a paralyzing sting.
